headline: Names a Tallmadge, Ohio post office building after Lance Corporal Daniel Nathan Deyarmin, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 162 Northeast Avenue in Tallmadge, Ohio, as the Lance Corporal Daniel Nathan Deyarmin, Jr., Post Office Building. It changes the official name of the building only and does not change how mail is handled there. The honor is symbolic.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 25, 2014.
